title: caralluma incarnata var. alba
intro: Caralluma incarnata var. alba, commonly known as a white or albino variant of the Caralluma incarnata plant, is a succulent species native to India and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits, including weight loss, improved appetite suppression, and enhanced mental clarity. The therapeutic actions of Caralluma incarnata var. alba are attributed to its ability to suppress appetite, reduce food intake, and improve glucose metabolism, which may aid in managing obesity and related health issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include pregnane glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among other compounds, which have been identified through various studies.
